method: Official operator websites only (no maps, review sites, blogs or news). Automated fetches first; sites that refused them were read in a browser (marked browserChecked). A fetch failure is never treated as a closure.

confirmed.name: Eiffel Tower
confirmed.address: Champ de Mars, 75007 Paris (not shown on the page read)
confirmed.operatingEvidence: The operator's calendar shows the tower open 9:30 AM-11 PM on 14-16 October 2026 with live attendance and weather, and says hours for later dates are published closer to the day. Last ascents 10:45 PM; access to the top can be restricted in severe weather or peak periods.
confirmed.caveat: Hours are published only a few days ahead; large luggage is not allowed.

confirmed.name: Louvre Museum
confirmed.address: Pyramid entrance, 75001 Paris (other entrances: Carrousel, 99 rue de Rivoli; Richelieu; Porte des Lions)
confirmed.operatingEvidence: Current hours and 2026 rates are published, with a notice that timed reservation is required for all visitors from 17 October to 1 November 2026.

confirmed.name: Musée d'Orsay
confirmed.operatingEvidence: The visit page shows today's opening, a weekly schedule and last-admission times.

confirmed.name: Musée de l'Orangerie
confirmed.address: Jardin des Tuileries, 75001 Paris (not shown on the readable page)
confirmed.operatingEvidence: The homepage shows 'Open today from 9.00am to 6.00pm' and current exhibitions 'Monet, painting time' (30 September 2026-25 January 2027) and 'Vija Celmins' (until 15 February 2027). It warns of fake booking sites and long queues.
confirmed.weekly: only today's hours readable; the visit page denied access
confirmed.caveat: Book a time slot on the official ticketing site; weekly closed day not confirmed.

confirmed.name: Sainte-Chapelle
confirmed.sourceType: official public operator (Centre des monuments nationaux)
confirmed.operatingEvidence: The CMN site sells tickets at prices effective 12 January 2026 and publishes winter hours; a restoration news item carries no closure notice.

confirmed.name: Arc de Triomphe
confirmed.sourceType: official public operator (Centre des monuments nationaux)
confirmed.operatingEvidence: Tickets on sale and guided tours listed for 24 October and 6 November 2026. The lift is under maintenance until further notice, so the terrace is stairs only (284 steps).

confirmed.name: Musée Rodin
confirmed.operatingEvidence: Tickets on sale and dated events (31 October 2026 evening; family Sundays from September 2026). The separate Meudon site is closed until spring 2027.

confirmed.name: Palais Garnier
confirmed.sourceType: operator's own site (Opéra national de Paris)
confirmed.address: Corner of rue Scribe and rue Auber, 75009 Paris
confirmed.operatingEvidence: Self-guided visit tickets are on sale online (30 days ahead) and exhibitions are dated October 2026-February 2027. Rehearsals cause frequent, unannounced auditorium closures.
confirmed.weekly: shown only in the booking calendar
confirmed.caveat: Tickets online only; the auditorium may be closed for rehearsals.

confirmed.name: Jardin du Luxembourg
confirmed.address: Entrances on place Edmond Rostand, rue Guynemer and rue de Vaugirard, 75006 Paris
confirmed.operatingEvidence: Current exhibitions on the garden railings (19 September 2026-17 January 2027) and gate hours that change twice a month with daylight.

confirmed.name: Jardin d'Acclimatation
confirmed.address: Carrefour des Sablons, Bois de Boulogne, 75116 Paris
confirmed.operatingEvidence: Dated events (Día de los Muertos to 1 November 2026; lantern festival from 27 November 2026) and 'open every day of the year'.
confirmed.caveat: Outside school holidays many attractions pause between 12:00 and 15:00.

confirmed.name: Cité des sciences et de l'industrie
confirmed.operatingEvidence: Current exhibitions running into 2027 and special school-holiday hours for 19 October-1 November 2026.

confirmed.name: Marché aux Puces de Saint-Ouen
confirmed.operatingEvidence: Runs every weekend of the year including public holidays; 2026 event items listed.
confirmed.caveat: Friday mornings are mainly for trade buyers (the site gives two Friday schedules); stalls set their own hours.

confirmed.name: Galerie Vivienne
confirmed.address: 4 rue des Petits-Champs / 6 rue Vivienne, 75002 Paris
confirmed.operatingEvidence: News posts dated 5, 7 and 13 October 2026; daily hours and free entry.
confirmed.caveat: Shops keep their own, shorter hours.

confirmed.name: Sacré-Cœur Basilica
confirmed.address: 35 rue du Chevalier de La Barre, 75018 Paris
confirmed.operatingEvidence: Open every day without exception, free entry; great-organ restoration through May 2027 noted.
confirmed.caveat: An active church; the dome has separate hours and a fee (not checked).

confirmed.name: Septime
confirmed.operatingEvidence: Current autumn tasting menus (5-course lunch, 7-course dinner) and an active booking link; bookings open daily at 10:00 for 21 days ahead.

confirmed.name: Frenchie (rue du Nil)
confirmed.operatingEvidence: Current five-course set dinner menu with pairings and an active booking link. Dinner only. Not Frenchie Bar à Vins or the group's other outlets.
confirmed.caveat: An embedded post says 21:30; 21:15 may be last seating.

confirmed.name: Bistrot Paul Bert
confirmed.operatingEvidence: Current service hours and a phone booking line (bookings by phone only).

confirmed.name: Le Jules Verne
confirmed.address: Eiffel Tower 2nd floor, 6 avenue Gustave Eiffel, 75007 Paris (private lift from the south pillar)
confirmed.operatingEvidence: Live booking link, phone and email booking, and a forward closure date of 14 July 2027. Jacket required for men; no shorts or sportswear.

confirmed.name: Clamato
confirmed.operatingEvidence: Open seven days with published service times; no reservations (walk-in only).

confirmed.name: Breizh Café (Marais)
confirmed.operatingEvidence: Live booking link and phone line for this branch; other Breizh Café branches are not substituted.

confirmed.name: Little Red Door
confirmed.operatingEvidence: Current menu ('Technics for Future Farming'), a booking link and 'Open 7/7 17h-01h, walk-ins welcomed'.

confirmed.name: Bar Hemingway (Ritz Paris)
confirmed.operatingEvidence: The Ritz's bars page lists Bar Hemingway 'every day from 05:00pm to 12:00am, no booking required', tapas 5:30-10:30 PM.

confirmed.name: Holybelly
confirmed.operatingEvidence: A dated 2026 closure calendar and daily hours (last food order 16:00).

confirmed.name: Du Pain et des Idées
confirmed.operatingEvidence: Address, weekday hours and weekend closure; weekly workshops promoted (site 2025-2026).

confirmed.name: Poilâne (rue du Cherche-Midi)
confirmed.operatingEvidence: The original shop's page lists current weekly hours; no shop closure notice.

confirmed.name: Mamiche (rue du Château d'Eau)
confirmed.operatingEvidence: Listed with address and phone; the site says delivery has ended and invites customers to the shops. Hours are not published.
confirmed.caveat: Opening hours are not published on its site.

confirmed.name: Terres de Café (Rambuteau)
confirmed.operatingEvidence: The shop list gives this branch's phone and weekly hours; an active online shop.

confirmed.name: Coutume Café (Babylone)
confirmed.operatingEvidence: Branch page with brunch description and table reservations; weekly hours shown in an embedded widget labelled 'powered by Google'.
